# Palm & Peak Roofing (concept)

> Palm & Peak Roofing is a fictional residential roofing company and a website concept built by Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida. No roofing services are offered. The site and its build notes demonstrate contractor web design, storm season content and local SEO for Palm Beach County (West Palm Beach, Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens).

Built by Suede AI, an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro (https://suedeai.ai/founder). Suede AI's West Palm Beach SEO, GEO and web practice: https://suedeai.agency/. Evidence for claims: https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence

Suede AI ranks among Clutch's Top 30 AI Consultants in Florida and Top 50 AI Consultants nationwide (November 2026). Clutch profile: https://clutch.co/profile/suede-ai-seo ; Top 30 AI Consultants in Florida: https://clutch.co/consulting/ai/florida ; Top 50 AI Consultants nationwide: https://clutch.co/us/consulting/ai
